private_network_health.method: ephemeral fixed-image health-only container on the original private network

boundaries.final_runner_start_changes: Fixed-image health-only container probes the proxy through the original private network; terminal runs return before network startup; first-403 receipts prevent upstream retry and are checked before delivery/scoring. Targeted regression tests and independent review cover these branches; clean prepare does not invoke them.

revisions.change: Generation isolation no longer adds host iptables INPUT rules (removed sudo -n iptables). The private network is internal with com.docker.network.bridge.inhibit_ipv4=true, so the host has no address on it; the model proxy runs as a container on the private network (alias vgb-proxy) plus a separate egress network; each start proves from the private network that the host gateway address and the model endpoint are unreachable; task containers drop NET_RAW.
files_changed: vendor/harness (8 default/selftest paths of the original installation replaced by placeholders under /opt; none on the suite execution path)
unchanged: scoring replay (original VerifierBench executor, rounds, metrics)
proxy request transform, 403 barrier and transport audit

revisions.change: User-facing name Veritas renamed to Gavel: suite and runner text, report label (<model> + Gavel) and artifact manifest harness name. Kept unchanged: VERITAS_* environment variables and data field names of the original framework, the vendored original framework code (except the neutral /opt/gavel placeholder paths), and runtime/ALIGNMENT_CONTRACT.md pinned by the runtime manifest.

Comments, docstrings and documentation no longer name internal hosts, paths, infrastructure or process notes. Two original-framework modules and their identifiers were renamed to generic names without changing logic, structure or inheritance: harbor_integration/box_provider.py (class BoxEnvironment, the base class of LocalDockerEnvironment) and harbor_integration/box_transport.py (box_run, BoxTransportError, BoxRunOutput). Name-like literals of the unused remote transport and of the non-suite executors were renamed the same way (environment variable names, the task image prefix, now harborbox, and a placeholder endpoint host). The model proxy no longer keeps one vendor-specific header in a refused response's receipt. README is bilingual and states the supported Docker version; runner/README.md describes the no-sudo network isolation; NOTICE.md adds the PRBench (CC BY 4.0) and tau2-bench (MIT) attributions and the Apache-2.0 license of the suite.
